name: Life Games
oneLine: Kick Me, NIGYSOB, See What You Made Me Do, Debtor, and Alcoholic are the classic games built around a person's basic stance toward life - not a single relationship, but a lifelong pattern.
whatYouDid: You watched the same shape repeat across four different people - Omar (Kick Me), Leah (NIGYSOB), Divya (See What You Made Me Do), and Farid (Debtor) - and chose the Adult response that named the pattern instead of completing it.

fromBook.quote: Jack is playing the game called Kick Me.

expand.definition: Life Games run deep enough to structure a whole biography, not just one evening: Kick Me (set up to be rejected, Persecutor-to-Victim), NIGYSOB (collect grievances, then reject, Victim-to-Persecutor), See What You Made Me Do (blame relocated onto someone else after your own mistake), Debtor (an unpaid balance that becomes a permanent identity), and Alcoholic (a five-handed game needing an Alcoholic, Persecutor, Rescuer, Patsy, and Connection to run).
expand.otherFraming: Alcoholic is unusual among these for needing a full cast - it can technically run with a couple of the five roles doubled up, but it works best, and lasts longest, with all five filled by different people.
expand.tryThisToday: Pick the Life Game you recognize most in your own patterns, and name which racket feeling it reliably delivers - that feeling is the stamp you're collecting.
